scope: 15 source-backed new identities relative to the frozen 200-business corpus; assistant-reviewed Jordan merchant metadata, not SMS, popularity ranking or independent gold.
purpose: Training-only coverage expansion; preserve original 200-business and holdout assignments. No eligibility for fitting until identity/provenance validation passes.
limitations: Name/default labels do not identify every transaction type.
Cash Withdrawals, Installments and Fees require transaction-context evidence; no bank identities are relabeled to manufacture these classes.
Historical source dates are disclosed. Public source evidence does not itself establish a dataset reuse license.
Digital services have Jordan-region/service evidence and no inferred local physical branches.

businesses.name: أمنية
businesses.notes: Telecom provider default; consistent with the user's monthly-mobile Telecom decision, not a generic recurring-bill Subscriptions rule.

sources.evidence: Official bilingual-branded company page identifies a Jordanian telecom and internet operator.

businesses.name: شركة الكهرباء الأردنية
businesses.notes: Electricity-provider merchant default; not the held-out Irbid electricity company.

sources.evidence: Official page names the electricity distribution company, JEPCO acronym and Amman origin.

businesses.name: مياهنا
businesses.notes: Water-provider default. Historical source establishes identity/activity, not current branch status or bank descriptor spelling.

sources.evidence: Company report names مياهنا and documents its Amman water/wastewater activity. Historical identity evidence.

businesses.name: شركة مياه اليرموك
businesses.notes: Water utility, distinct from Yarmouk University and the held-out Irbid electricity provider.

sources.evidence: Official contact page names the water company and Irbid headquarters.
Official site describes water services, distribution and subscriber services.

businesses.name: باص رؤية
businesses.notes: Public-transport fares/top-ups default to Transportation; not proof that a monthly commuting pass should override the user's Subscriptions boundary.

sources.evidence: Current operator page brands the public bus service باص رؤية and describes Amman transport and stored-value ticketing.

businesses.name: Uber
businesses.notes: Ride-service default for Jordan; not a universal category for unrelated services or generic platform payments. No Careem alias or separate Careem brand is counted.

sources.evidence: Official Jordan article names أوبر and its licensed local ride service. Historical licensing evidence.

businesses.name: جوبترول
businesses.notes: Motor-fuel station default follows the user's Transportation choice for Manaseer. Explicit household heating fuel or a concession cafe purchase needs context.

sources.evidence: Official page describes the Jordanian company's local fuel-station service under جوبترول.
English company page uses JoPetrol and describes fuel-station and vehicle services in Jordan.

sources.publisher: Jordan University of Science and Technology

businesses.name: الجامعة الأردنية
businesses.notes: Education default for the university identity. Administrative/personal transfers mentioning a university need transaction-level evidence.

businesses.name: جامعة عمان العربية
businesses.notes: Education default; distinct from the University of Jordan and Yarmouk University. Historical 2024 report is name/activity evidence.

businesses.name: الأردنية للطيران
businesses.notes: Airline travel default; distinct from Royal Jordanian, not an extra branch or invented translation of that existing brand.

sources.evidence: Official Arabic page names Jordan Aviation, الأردنية للطيران and JAV, and describes its Jordanian airline operations.

businesses.name: دالاس للسياحة والسفر

businesses.name: Netflix
businesses.notes: Subscription-provider default consistent with the user's exact Netflix renewal label; not a human-reviewed new business label.
